title: Maria's Party
text:
Maria has a big party. She invites twenty friends. Her mom buys forty cupcakes and thirty sandwiches. There are fifty balloons in the room.

The party starts at four o'clock. Maria's friends bring many gifts. At the end, Maria counts them and there are one hundred gifts. She is very happy.

questions.text: How many friends does Maria invite?
What time does the party start?
How does Maria probably feel at the end of the party?
Why does Maria's mom buy so many cupcakes and sandwiches?

vocabulary.definition: a social event where people eat, play and celebrate
asks someone to come to an event
colorful bags filled with air or gas, used for decoration
things that you give to someone on a special occasion

paragraph_translations: Maria tiene una fiesta grande. Invita a veinte amigos. Su mamá compra cuarenta magdalenas y treinta sándwiches. Hay cincuenta globos en la habitación.
La fiesta empieza a las cuatro en punto. Los amigos de María traen muchos regalos. Al final, María los cuenta y hay cien regalos. Ella está muy contenta.
